task: Implement two-pass evidence-based playback diagnosis plus exact-provenance source refresh
diagnostic_findings: Unfiltered random movie selection can produce NO_SOURCE; readiness/timeline checks must be marked BLOCKED rather than independent decoder failures.
Some audio/quality selection controls return synchronous status=completed; previously acceptance demanded asynchronous operationId and falsely failed.
Previously Media3-successful direct movie sample provides historical evidence, not guaranteed present playback.
Episode media.details may fail MEDIA_NOT_FOUND; do not run/attribute downstream player checks.
HDRezka adapter already had strict saved article provenance, but content_filler did not pass known_sources; direct search endpoint was ACCESS_DENIED.

changes.acceptance: Seed-reproducible random coverage and separate recent first-frame control; typed cause and blockedBy metadata; coverage/player/metadata/backend metrics; sync completed agent action support; first-frame/READY/timeline checks; strict release gate unchanged.
changes.provenance: Exact row ID+year+title+kind+provider article verification; deduplicate to one seed/article; use known_sources and force_refresh to bypass stale search cache only with saved provenance; article transport uses original observed ref; no URL guessing or access bypass.
changes.checkpoint_dependency: Includes related previously uncommitted provider_discovery, hdrezka_provider_adapter, hdrezka_transport and provenance tests as reproducible source dependencies.

qa.android_random_sample_note: A 29-check release run is not comparable to the older 24-check acceptance; v1/v2 use the same seed but live network and data remain variable.

production_snapshot.note: +6 persisted movie-card delta is incidental concurrent enrichment, not proven causal playback improvement

safety_limits: No guarantee that provider is accessible after article refresh
No fabricated stream URLs or title guessing
First-frame not established on the new historical control in Android run (operation timeout)
No Kotlin/app binary modification; acceptance script and background worker only
Unrelated uncommitted UI/runtime changes excluded from checkpoint
